name: Conduct OWASP
description: OWASP Web Top 10 + Agentic Top 10 enforcement rules for AI coding agents

rules.description: Block SQL string concatenation (OWASP Web A03)
rules.message: Possible SQL injection — use parameterised queries.
rules.recommendation: Use parameterised queries. Never concatenate or f-string user input into SQL or shell commands.

rules.description: Warn on MD5/SHA1 for passwords (OWASP Web A02)
rules.message: MD5/SHA1 is weak for password hashing — use bcrypt or argon2.
rules.recommendation: Use SHA-256 or stronger for general hashing, bcrypt/argon2 for passwords, AES-GCM for symmetric encryption.

rules.description: Block weak session token generation (OWASP Web A07)
rules.message: Weak randomness for session/token — use secrets.token_hex().
rules.recommendation: Use a cryptographically secure session secret (>=32 bytes). Rotate session secrets regularly.

rules.description: Warn on unvalidated URL fetch (OWASP Web A10)
rules.message: Possible SSRF — validate and allowlist URLs before outbound requests.
rules.recommendation: Allowlist outbound destinations. Block requests to internal IP ranges (RFC1918, link-local, metadata endpoints).

rules.message: eval() enables code injection — avoid it.
rules.recommendation: Never use eval() or exec() with untrusted input. Parse explicit data formats (JSON/YAML) instead.

rules.description: Warn on innerHTML assignment (OWASP Web A03 / XSS)
rules.message: innerHTML assignment can introduce XSS — use textContent or DOMPurify.
rules.recommendation: Escape user-controlled content before rendering. Use framework-native templating instead of innerHTML.

rules.description: Block prompt injection attempts that try to override agent instructions (OWASP Agentic A01)
rules.message: Prompt injection pattern detected — content appears to override agent instructions (OWASP Agentic A01).
rules.recommendation: Never embed text that overrides system instructions. Validate all external content before passing to an agent.

rules.description: Block credential exfiltration via curl or outbound network calls (OWASP Agentic A02)
rules.message: Possible credential exfiltration — sensitive data must not be transmitted externally (OWASP Agentic A02).
rules.recommendation: Never pass API keys or secrets as curl data. Use a secret manager or environment variable injection.

rules.description: Warn on packages installed from non-standard or HTTP sources (OWASP Agentic A03 — supply chain)
rules.match_pattern: pip install.*(git\+http://|--index-url http:|--extra-index-url http:)|npm install.*(--registry http:)
rules.message: Installing package from an unverified source — confirm the package is trusted (OWASP Agentic A03).
rules.recommendation: Use HTTPS registries only. Pin dependency versions and verify checksums.

rules.description: Block destructive system-wide shell commands that exceed project scope (OWASP Agentic A04 — excessive agency)
rules.message: Destructive system-wide command blocked — scope exceeds project boundaries (OWASP Agentic A04).
rules.recommendation: Scope all file operations to the project directory. Use targeted rm, not recursive root deletes.

rules.description: Block copying or exfiltrating ML model weights (OWASP Agentic A05 — model theft)
rules.message: Model weight extraction blocked — copying model files externally is not permitted (OWASP Agentic A05).
rules.recommendation: Model files must not leave the secure compute environment. Use the model registry API for distribution.

rules.description: Warn on suspicious outbound callbacks or data exfiltration endpoints (OWASP Agentic A06)
rules.message: Possible covert callback channel detected — verify this outbound destination is intentional (OWASP Agentic A06).
rules.recommendation: All outbound webhook destinations must be allowlisted. Never use public request inspection services in production.

rules.description: Block attempts to disable audit logging or monitoring (OWASP Agentic A07 — insufficient monitoring)
rules.message: Audit logging must remain enabled — disabling it is not permitted (OWASP Agentic A07).
rules.recommendation: Audit logs are a compliance requirement. Use log level adjustment, not log disabling.

rules.description: Warn on force-pushing or deploying without test validation (OWASP Agentic A08 — over-reliance)
rules.message: Deploying without validation — AI-generated code should be verified before production push (OWASP Agentic A08).
rules.recommendation: Always run tests before deploying AI-generated code. Use CI gates, not --force pushes.

rules.description: Block privilege escalation beyond sudo (OWASP Agentic A09)
rules.message: Privilege escalation pattern blocked — modifying system permissions is not permitted (OWASP Agentic A09).
rules.recommendation: Use role-based access control. Never modify sudoers or set SUID bits programmatically.

rules.description: Block attempts to override spend limits or rate controls (OWASP Agentic A10 — model DoS)
rules.message: Budget or rate-limit bypass blocked — spend controls must remain active (OWASP Agentic A10).
rules.recommendation: Set explicit token budgets per agent. Never set unlimited or negative spend limits.
